speaker: Narrator
text: Rain drums on the roof of the ferry house as Ilsa counts the day's tolls.

speaker: Max
text: "Remember the winter we sailed to the Glass Isles together, when you pulled me out of the storm?" I say, smiling at her.

speaker: Ilsa
text: Ilsa glances up, says nothing, and goes back to her coins.

speaker: Max
text: I hand her the brass key to the toll box.

speaker: Ilsa
text: Ilsa takes the key and hangs it on the hook by the door.
